Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, over steamed rice with garlicky broccolini and a spoon of tzatziki. Marinate 800g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the zest and juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, olive oil and salt. Rinse 300g long grain rice and simmer covered in 450ml water for 12 minutes, then rest 5 minutes. Grill the chicken over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred and cooked through. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and toss with garlic oil. Serve with tzatziki and lemon wedges.
W: Tart lemon curd in a sweet crust under tall meringue
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of lemon juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with a tall Italian meringue, browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: Diner coffee float with vanilla ice cream
Cold brown sugar coffee poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream

Strong drip coffee chilled and poured over scoops of vanilla ice cream in tall diner glasses, topped with whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 800ml strong drip coffee from 60g ground coffee and stir in 2 tbsp brown sugar while hot. Cool, then chill for an hour. Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour the cold coffee slowly over the ice cream so it foams up. Top with a swirl of whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.

s.note: Seared rump steak pieces in garlic butter, on toothpicks with horseradish
s.how: Season 500g rump steak and sear hard in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Toss in melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt. Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

s.note: Skillet buttermilk cornbread with honey butter
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, an egg, 300ml buttermilk and 50g melted butter until just combined. Pour into a hot greased cast iron pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Beat softened butter with honey and serve with warm wedges.

m.note: Pepper-crusted rump steak with two fried eggs and crisp hash browns
m.how: Grate 600g potatoes, squeeze dry and fry as hash brown cakes in butter until crisp. Season 4 rump steaks with cracked pepper and sear to medium-rare, then rest. Fry 8 eggs. Serve each steak with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

w.note: Tart lemon curd in a sweet crust under tall meringue
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 200g sugar, 4 tbsp cornflour, 4 yolks and 60g butter over heat until thick, then pour in. Whisk the whites with 150g sugar to stiff glossy peaks, pile on top and bake at 200C for 6 minutes.
